chunks: And with this chain of transmission, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Safwan, from Ibn Miskan, from al-Halabi, who said:
I asked Aba 'Abdillah عليه السلام about kissing: does it invalidate wudu (ablution)? He said: There is no harm in it.

key_terms.الْقُبْلَةِ: kissing; the act being asked about in relation to ritual purity
key_terms.الْوُضُوءَ: wudu (ablution); the state of ritual purification before worship
key_terms.تَنْقُضُ: invalidate or nullify; used here regarding whether wudu is broken
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; an expression indicating permissibility or no invalidation

ai.seo_question: Does kissing invalidate wudu (ablution) according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states that kissing does not invalidate wudu (ablution). It is a jurisprudential report relevant to the rulings of ritual purity.
